hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored standalone katzFD, in the field-standard amplitude-only convention, reproduces BOTH antropy.katz_fd AND NeuroKit2 fractal_katz BIT-FOR-BIT; and this amplitude-only value differs materially from the earlier Euclidean-plane convention the shipped op used.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: katzFD equals antropy.katz_fd AND NeuroKit2 fractal_katz to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9 vs each)
